title: Consciousness
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 25.3 Linked Discourses 25.3
  • 1. Cakkhuvagga 1. The Eye

Viññāṇasutta Consciousness

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Cakkhuviññāṇaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi; “Mendicants, eye consciousness is impermanent, decaying, and perishing. sotaviññāṇaṁ … Ear consciousness, ghānaviññāṇaṁ … nose consciousness, jivhāviññāṇaṁ … tongue consciousness, kāyaviññāṇaṁ … body consciousness, manoviññāṇaṁ aniccaṁ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi. and mind consciousness are impermanent, decaying, and perishing.

Yo bhikkhave …pe… Someone who has faith and confidence in these teachings is called a follower by faith. …” sambodhiparāyano”ti.

Tatiyaṁ.
